selection: private independent human-authored tasks after whole-family holdout; balance modes across domains; no generated reference without independent verification
family_policy: connected components of document editions, solutions, screenshots, paraphrases, repository duplicates and prompt collisions assigned before curation; uncertain links withheld
private_storage: outside public Git; separate access-controlled question, answer, grader and asset manifests
rag_policy: sealed question/answer/solution families excluded from index; source-grounded tasks use a frozen allowed reference family set containing no task answers; development tasks use different families

grader.numeric: independent oracle, units, absolute/relative tolerances fixed before outputs
grader.conceptual: blind rubric review with explicit assumptions and errors
grader.citation: document hash, location, offset/asset fidelity, entailment and answer coverage
grader.abstention: missing-context tasks require justified refusal rather than invented values

comparison.baseline: same pinned base, prompt template, decoder, tools and index as trained model
comparison.sampling: do_sample=false; fixed max_new_tokens and im_end stop; same context budget
comparison.development: checkpoint selection on separate dev families only
comparison.sealed_gold: one final frozen baseline-versus-adapter comparison; no tuning on gold feedback
comparison.report: per-domain/mode pass rates, error taxonomy, paired differences with uncertainty, units, citation precision and latency
